detail: Standardised 16 column names (short, snake/Title case, units dropped)
Trimmed spaces + Title-cased Locality ('bidholi','nanda ki chowki','Prem nagar ' etc.): 12 -> 9 unique values
'Shared Flat / PG' merged into 'PG (Shared)' (same concept, 1 row)
Gender: missing + 'Prefer not to say' -> 'Undisclosed' (kept, not dropped)
Added Housing (Hostel/PG/Flat/Home) and Stream_Group for stable group statistics
Allowance: 1 missing -> median of same Housing group (+ Allowance_Imputed flag)
Commute: 1 missing -> median of same Housing group (+ Commute_Imputed flag)
Stress: 1 missing -> median of same Housing group (+ Stress_Imputed flag)
Cast ID/Year/Age/Stress to integer; money columns to float
Age vs Year plausibility (expected age ~ 17+Year): flagged implausible rows
Itemised total vs respondent's Reported_Total differs by >25%: flagged (Computed_Total, the sum of the 4 items, is used as the modelling target)
Hostel students report Rent=0 -> hostel fee is NOT in their cost; flagged so cost comparisons across housing are interpreted correctly
Tukey 1.5*IQR fences on 7 money columns: outlier rows flagged and RETAINED (genuine high-income / side-earning students, not errors)
